title: Surcingle
summary: SUR'CINGLE, noun [Latin cingulum, a belt.] 1. A belt, band or girth which passes over a saddle, or over any thing laid on a horse's back, to bind it fast. 2. The girdle of a cassoc.

inlines.v: SUR'CINGLE, noun [Latin cingulum, a belt.] 1. A belt, band or girth which passes over a saddle, or over any thing laid on a horse's back, to bind it fast. 2. The girdle of a cassoc.
